clarity_recommendations: Use two explicit lanes: Recorded game (observed) and Engine search (hypothetical). Give source unknowns a distinct appearance, never an empty-zone appearance.
First match is both players at the end of the user's first turn: 2 player milestones, 1 time boundary, 6 enforced fields. It is transition 10.before; transition 10.after is opponent Upkeep.

The source records Terramorphic Expanse played and Island in play at opponent's first end-of-turn. Show these as separate recorded facts, not an invented exact activation/sacrifice sequence; ability ID 88024 is not mapped.

The failed branch shares actions 0 through 10, then passes without playing a land and discards Forest at action 21. Source opponent hand identities are hidden; all shown engine opponent hand cards are hypotheses.
Actions 11 through 20 are retained without intermediate state snapshots. Do not animate invented intermediate states; show a gap or compact label for the unretained interval.
The boundary adapter refuses to compare the next source checkpoint across this non-neutral cleanup transition. Do not label a missing comparison a mismatch, or the branch a proof of an engine bug.
Forest moving Hand to Graveyard is retained exactly in native events. Graveyard count becomes 1; this is the only named graveyard card supported by this branch event.

The source expected opponent Island versus the branch empty battlefield is useful visually, but the system did not emit boundary actuals or an enforced mismatch at that point. Label it a visual contrast, not a completed check.

Tap flags are absent from the projected state. Render upright cards as display layout only, with a visible tap-state-unavailable note. A PermanentUntapped event exists for Sundown Pass in the failure transition, but does not supply complete tap flags for these snapshots.
Other source permanent zones are blank/unknown, including creatures; rendering a source land zone must say Lands observed, not Complete battlefield.
Card art is a name-matched illustration, not proof of the exact Arena printing. Preserve visible card names when external images fail.
proposed_narrative: The recording gives us checkpoints, not every action.
We can reproduce the first checkpoint: Sundown Pass in play, six known cards left in the user's hand, both players at 20 life, opponent holding seven unknown cards.
The next checkpoint requires an Island in the opponent's lands and records Terramorphic Expanse played during that turn.
One search branch instead passes, reaches cleanup with eight cards, and discards Forest.
The engine can take the discard action. Our checkpoint mapper cannot yet compare across a cleanup action that changes cards, so this branch produces an adapter issue.
The improvement made this previously opaque failure inspectable. It did not make this game fit: the same two player milestones match and all six issue signatures remain.
